desc:
⭕ Don’t Leave the Circle!
Be the last player standing inside the red circle and win!

Survive each day by keeping your stats under control:
🍔 Food | 💧 Water | 🚽 Toilet | 🚿 Shower | 😴 Sleep

Every day you get food water, shower, and every night you can sleep to restore energy.
But be careful — daily minigames like parkour, zombies, lasers and more can change everything! 🏃‍♂️⚽

Can you survive longer than everyone else? 👑
